messages:
marta: Heads up — staging canary for the base-image refresh failed during containerd startup. OOM-ish crash but logs show KMS unwrap errors and no signer identity in audit logs. @jason can you take a look?

jason: On it. can you paste the error lines or attach the pod logs?

marta: pasted logs from pod (truncated):
```
E0312 11:04:22 containerd: failed to create shim: failed to set cgroups: permission denied
E0312 11:04:22 kms: unwrap failed: 403 KeyAccessDenied for key "projects/prod/keys/signer-01"
E0312 11:04:22 auth: signer id missing from audit entry
```

deploy-bot: build-canary-3741 failed (exit 1) — see staging pod "canary-3741" logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/3741 :x:

priya: quick thought: we recently flipped cgroup v2 default in the new base. If the runtime was built expecting cgroup v1 the container runtime can blow up at start. Also admission controller might reject privileged cgroup ops, which could strip the signer annotation. Did the image layer change syscall policy?

dan: also, the KMS 403 suggests the ephemeral signer SA used by the builder doesn't have KeyDecrypt on the customer keystore. We recently tightened role bindings in the keystore project. We should check the IAM binding for serviceAccount:builder@infra.svc\.. Could be an RBAC regression.

jason: confirmed the shim stack shows "failed to set cgroups: operation not permitted" before the KMS error. ordering suggests runtime couldn't initialize and then the signing step failed to attach metadata.

priya: mitigation proposal: 1) redeploy canary with CGROUP_MODE=legacy (env override) 2) rollback to previous signed layer while we validate keystore bindings 3) add a short preflight that checks cgroup support in node images

dan: RBAC fix (if we need it) would be: bind builder SA to kms.decrypt role in the keystore project. example: 
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: builder-kms-decrypt
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: kms-decrypt
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: builder
  namespace: infra
EOF
```
(also need IAM mapping on cloud side for key decrypt)

jason: ok i'm going to run the CGROUP_MODE canary now and also check the keystore IAM audit. if we need an emergency RBAC change i can push it but prefer to validate first.

oncall: INC-2345 created to track this: https://tickets.internal/INC-2345 — oncall will own rollbacks and communications. tagging sec-runbook.

marta: quick q for product/ops: what is the audit log retention for hosted vs private deployments? if signer id is missing we need to pull historical logs.

dan: hosted default audit retention is 14 days; Private deployments are customer-controlled — many customers run 30/90/365 day retention depending on compliance. we should add a short note to the runbook about where to look per deployment type.

jason: canary redeploy started (canary-3741-retry) with CGROUP_MODE=legacy. will report back in ~5m.

marta: :thumbsup: please post the diff and the IAM check results when you have them. thanks everyone.
